description: Analyzes a step response from a plant to identify its First-Order Plus Dead Time (FOPDT) parameters: Gain (K), Time Constant (tau), and Dead Time (theta). Requires a completed simulation with a step input connected to the plant. Returns the calculated parameters.

blockId.description: Scope or Display block ID showing the plant output

stepTime.description: Time when the step input occurred (default: 0)

name: identify_fopdt
title: Identify FOPDT model
